Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team is excited. After an internal compliance review we need two one-time concessions to move forward with a 3-month pilot:

- Relax the uptime SLO from 99.95% to 99.5% for the first 12 months of the contract.

We understand this is nonstandard. We’re prepared to sign a redlined SLA and accelerate procurement (our procurement contact Mark is cc’d). There’s also a modest onboarding/implementation discount request (15%) tied to the concession.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve this via deal desk or whether we need exec sign-off? We’d like to close by the end of next week.

Best,

Ben — I reviewed the requested concessions and Deal Desk thresholds. Summary and recommendation: 

- SLO relaxation from 99.95% to 99.5% for 12 months: operationally acceptable for a pilot, but this is outside standard commercial bounds for enterprise customers. Requires VP/GM (Aditya) approval.
- Service credit cap 25% + removal of termination right: material legal change. Legal wants to keep termination carve-outs; removing the right entirely is high risk.
- 15% onboarding discount: can be approved by Deal Desk up to 10% — anything above needs sales leadership sign-off.

Please route to Aditya for the final greenlight. Attaching the redline from Legal and a short deal summary for exec review.

2) Remedy exposure: cap cumulative service credits at 25% of monthly fees for any 30-day period. Keep termination rights for repeated major breaches; remove the automatic termination right for small/isolated breaches as requested. We’ll prescribe specific breach definitions in the redline.
3) Discount: approve a 12% onboarding/implementation discount (compromise between the request and Deal Desk limit).

Conditions:
- These concessions are a one-time approval tied to DEAL-8473 only.
- We need a signed addendum with redlined SLA and a 12-month measurement window documented.
- Marketing/sales may not publicize these terms (nonstandard).

Lauren: please prepare the addendum and a short exec summary for the VP’s signature. Ben: once signed, route DocuSign link to Stanton.
